description: This Java source file defines the 'DraggableDot' custom View class, implementing drag-and-drop behavior with visual feedback, customizable attributes, and simulated delays for debugging or testing ANRs.

classes.name: DraggableDot
classes.description: A custom View that represents a draggable circle with optional legend text, supporting drag-and-drop operations, customizable appearance, and simulation of ANRs for testing.

classes.name: ANRShadowBuilder
classes.description: Inner class extending DragShadowBuilder to optionally simulate a long drawing delay (ANR) during drag shadow rendering.

methods.name: sleepSixSeconds
methods.description: Pauses execution for approximately six seconds, used to simulate ANRs.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides View's method to draw the circle, legend text, and glow effects if dragging.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Sets the View's dimensions based on the radius and padding.

methods.name: onDragEvent
methods.description: Handles drag events, updates visual states, and processes dropped data.

methods.name: setReportView
methods.description: Assigns a TextView to display information about drag-and-drop operations.

methods.name: processDrop
methods.description: Processes the data from a drag event and updates the report view.
